Container.Name: Whisper-asr-CPU
Container.Overview: CPU-ONLY Whisper ASR Webservice (no NVIDIA GPU required): speech-to-text over a simple HTTP API (transcribe or translate audio/video, with word-level timestamps; output as txt, srt, vtt, tsv or json). Transcription runs on the CPU and system RAM: it works, but is MUCH slower than GPU (roughly 5-15x; a 50-minute episode can take well over an hour). Uses the official onerahmet CPU image unchanged, so it updates normally with the Docker "Update" button.[br][br][b]Upgrading from an older version of this template:[/b] if your container has two "SubSyncarr patch" paths (Edit container, Show more settings), clear both of them and click Apply. Older versions of this template filled them in, and they stop the container from starting after an image update.
Container.Changes: ### 2026.11.25 - Standalone: removed the two "SubSyncarr patch" file mappings. The container now runs the official image as-is, so image updates can no longer break it. - If you installed an older version: Edit the container, clear the two "SubSyncarr patch" paths (Show more settings), and click Apply. Your settings and downloaded models are kept. - New installs use the official CPU image (:latest), which is much smaller than the GPU image. Existing installs on :latest-gpu keep working; switching the Repository to :latest is optional. - Added the new optional settings from Whisper ASR Webservice 1.11: API_KEY, ASR_VAD_FILTER, LOG_LEVEL. - Models path default is now /mnt/user/appdata/whisper-asr.
Container.Requires: No GPU and no Nvidia Driver plugin needed. Give it plenty of RAM (large-v3 int8 on CPU wants about 6-10 GB; the --memory cap in Extra Parameters is a safety ceiling - adjust to taste). First start downloads the model (large-v3 is about 3 GB) to the Models path below. If you also run the GPU container, change this one's host PORT (e.g. 9001) so they don't collide.

Config.Name: WebUI / API Port
Config.Description: HTTP API + Swagger docs (http://host:9000/docs). Change the host port if a GPU Whisper container already uses 9000.

Config.Name: ASR_ENGINE
Config.Description: Engine: faster_whisper (recommended: fastest on CPU), openai_whisper, or whisperx.

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL
Config.Description: Model: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. On a weak CPU, 'medium' or 'small' trade accuracy for a big speed-up.

Config.Name: ASR_QUANTIZATION
Config.Description: int8 = smallest + fastest on CPU. (float32/float16 are slower and heavier on CPU.)

Config.Name: ASR_MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Where models are stored INSIDE the container. Must match the Models host-path mapping below.

Config.Name: ASR_DEVICE
Config.Description: cpu = run entirely on the processor + RAM. No GPU is requested.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Host folder that persists downloaded models. Keeps the model OUT of the docker image.

Config.Name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
Config.Description: CPU threads used for transcription. Set near your core count for best speed.

Config.Name: MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before the model is unloaded from RAM (0 = keep loaded). Set e.g. 300 to free RAM between jobs at the cost of a reload delay.

Config.Name: ASR_VAD_FILTER
Config.Description: true = skip silent parts of the audio by default (voice activity detection, faster_whisper only). Each request can still override it.

Config.Name: API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. When set, every request must send this key in the X-API-Key header. Leave empty for no key.
